def generate_moves(board, role):
    moves = []
    opponent = "black" if role == "white" else "white"
    forward = 1 if role == "white" else -1
    for (x,y), color in board.items():
        if color != role:
            continue
        # forward move
        nx = x
        ny = y + forward
        if 1 <= nx <= BOARD_SIZE and 1 <= ny <= BOARD_SIZE and (nx,ny) not in board:
            moves.append((x,y,nx,ny))
        # diagonal capture left
        nx_l = x - 1
        ny_l = y + forward
        if 1 <= nx_l <= BOARD_SIZE and 1 <= ny_l <= BOARD_SIZE and board.get((nx_l,ny_l)) == opponent:
            moves.append((x,y,nx_l,ny_l))
        # diagonal capture right
        nx_r = x + 1
        ny_r = y + forward
        if 1 <= nx_r <= BOARD_SIZE and 1 <= ny_r <= BOARD_SIZE and board.get((nx_r,ny_r)) == opponent:
            moves.append((x,y,nx_r,ny_r))
    return moves

def evaluate(board, role):
    # terminal check
    opponent = "black" if role == "white" else "white"
    # if role has piece on opposite end
    if role == "white":
        for (x,y), color in board.items():
            if color == role and y == BOARD_SIZE:
                return 10000
    else: # black
        for (x,y), color in board.items():
            if color == role and y == 1:
                return 10000
    # if opponent already at its goal => lose
    if opponent == "white":
        for (x,y), color in board.items():
            if color == opponent and y == BOARD_SIZE:
                return -10000
    else:
        for (x,y), color in board.items():
            if color == opponent and y == 1:
                return -10000

    # piece values
    my_score = 0
    opp_score = 0
    my_moves = len(generate_moves(board, role))
    opp_moves = len(generate_moves(board, opponent))
    # compute piece contributions
    for (x,y), color in board.items():
        if color == role:
            # progress
            if role == "white":
                progress = y - 1
            else:
                progress = BOARD_SIZE - y
            my_score += progress * 10 + 5
            # center control
            center = max(0, 3 - abs(x - 4.5))
            my_score += center
        else: # opponent

            else:

            opp_score += progress * 10 + 5
            center = max(0, 3 - abs(x - 4.5))
            opp_score += center

    mobility_score = (my_moves - opp_moves) * 0.5

    total = my_score - opp_score + mobility_score
    return total

    opponent = "black" if role == "white" else "white"
